description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) NO ESCAPE (Shadowkeepers, 2 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (the Orks' Movement phase). The Ork player falls the Boyz back 2.5" out of engagement with Custodian Guard A: enemy_ended_move opens for P2 with move_type fall_back; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard...' (unengaged INFANTRY within 6") spends 2 CP: the Guard declares a charge against the Boyz, rolls 2D6 and, if it reaches, ends engaged with Fights First.
